EL 4.0
The EL 4.0 is an Enapter AEM electrolyser described as the equipment in the source document. The following table contains technical specifications for the EL 4.0.<SEP>The EL 4.0, also referred to as EL40, AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0, or AEM Electrolyser EL40, is an Enapter AEM electrolyser that generates hydrogen by water electrolysis and is specified by production rate, purity, output pressure, power consumption, heat dissipation, utilities, environmental limits, dimensions, weight, control interfaces, and conformity marks.

Enapter
Enapter is the organization or brand named in the product designation Enapter EL 4.0 AEM electrolyser.<SEP>Enapter is the manufacturer of the EL 4.0 electrolyser and the provider of the EMS used for its control and monitoring.

Technical Specifications Table
The following table contains technical specifications for the EL 4.0 AEM electrolyser.

Production Rate
The EL 4.0 production rate is up to 500 NL/h, up to 1.0785 kg/24 h.

Hydrogen Output Purity
The EL 4.0 hydrogen output purity is 99.9% (< 1,000 ppm H₂O and < 5 ppm O₂) at 25 °C at 35 barg, and 98.8% (< 12,000 ppm H₂O and < 5 ppm O₂) at 25 °C at 8 barg.

Output Pressure
The EL 4.0 output pressure is up to 35 barg.

data.entity_name: Nominal Power Consumption Per Nm³ of H₂ Produced
data.content:
Nominal Power Consumption Per Nm³ of H₂ Produced
The EL 4.0 nominal power consumption per Nm³ of H₂ produced is 4.8 kWh/Nm³, beginning of life.

Operative Power Consumption
The EL 4.0 operative power consumption is 2.4 kW, beginning of life.

Peak Power Consumption
The EL 4.0 peak power consumption is 3 kW.

Heat Dissipation
The EL 4.0 heat dissipation is 0.6 kW, beginning of life.

Max Heat Dissipation
The EL 4.0 max heat dissipation is 0.9 kW, end of life.

Standby Power Consumption
The EL 4.0 standby power consumption is 0.3 kW.

Power Supply
The EL 4.0 power supply is 220 – 240 V (AC), 50/60 Hz.

Maximum Water Input Conductivity
The EL 4.0 maximum water input conductivity requirement is a minimum of ASTM D1193-06 Type IV, or recommended Type II or Type III.

Water Consumption
The EL 4.0 water consumption is ~ 420 mL/h at 25 °C.

Water Input Pressure Range
The EL 4.0 water input pressure range is 1 – 4 barg.

Ambient Operative Temperature Range
The EL 4.0 ambient operative temperature range is 5 °C – 45 °C.

Ambient Operative Humidity Range
The EL 4.0 ambient operative humidity range is up to 90% humidity, non-condensing.

IP Rating
The EL 4.0 IP rating is IP 20.

Dimensions
The EL 4.0 dimensions are W: 482 mm × D: 635 mm × H: 266 mm.

Weight
The EL 4.0 weight is 42 kg.

Space Inside Cabinet
The EL 4.0 requires 6 U of space inside the cabinet.

Control and Monitoring
The EL 4.0 control and monitoring is fully automatic with Enapter's EMS via 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth and Modbus TCP over Ethernet.

Enapter's EMS
Enapter's EMS provides fully automatic control and monitoring of the EL 4.0 through 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth and Modbus TCP over Ethernet.

Conformity
The EL 4.0 conformity comprises the CE mark according to the machine directive 2006/42/CE, the UKCA mark according to Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008, and CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1 for hydrogen generators using water electrolysis in industrial, commercial, and residential applications.

CE Mark
The CE mark is applied to the EL 4.0 according to the machine directive 2006/42/CE.

UKCA Mark
The UKCA mark is applied to the EL 4.0 according to the Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008.

CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1
CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1 covers hydrogen generators using water electrolysis for industrial, commercial, and residential applications and applies to the EL 4.0.

ASTM D1193-06
ASTM D1193-06 specifies reagent water types; Type IV is the minimum acceptable water input quality for the EL 4.0, with Type II or Type III recommended.

Hydrogen
Hydrogen (H₂) is the product of the EL 4.0, generated at up to 500 NL/h or up to 1.0785 kg/24 h.

Water
Water is an input utility for the EL 4.0, consumed at approximately 420 mL/h at 25 °C, supplied at 1 – 4 barg and meeting a maximum conductivity requirement of minimum ASTM D1193-06 Type IV or recommended Type II or Type III.

Electricity
Electricity is the power input for the EL 4.0, supplied at 220 – 240 V (AC), 50/60 Hz.

Oxygen
Oxygen (O₂) appears as an impurity in the EL 4.0 hydrogen output at less than 5 ppm.

Water Electrolysis
Water electrolysis is the process by which the EL 4.0 generates hydrogen from water.
